messages.subject: Re: is there a way to load the Deducer package without using JGR?
messages.subject_clean: is there a way to load the Deducer package without using JGR?
messages.body_plain:
yes, you can load deducer in the usual way (i.e. library(Deducer) ).
Or is you want to load deducer with no gui elements, you can use:

options(DeducerNoGUI=TRUE)
library(Deducer)

messages.subject: Standard Error Calculation
messages.body_plain:
Hello Everyone,

I am a big fan of Deducer!

I am using the errorbar geom and want to calculate the standard
error.  I choose summary and then custom.  I am suppose to input the
'y function', the 'y-min function', 'the y-max function', 'the data
function.'

Can anyone help me with how I should input these functions?  I know
the formula for Standard Error, but am not quite sure how to input a
function into Deducer to calculate these functions.

thanks,
Vivek

messages.subject: Re: Standard Error Calculation
messages.body_plain:
Vivek,

you will want

function(x) mean(x)

function(x) mean(x) - sd(x)/sqrt(length(x))

function(x) mean(x) + sd(x)/sqrt(length(x))

and don't put anything in the data function box.

see the attached plot for an example.

Cheers,
Ian
